# Open Ethics Standard

> An MCP server (https://mcp.codebylevel.com/mcp) that lets an AI coding assistant diagnose harmful practices (dark patterns, privacy traps, billing tricks) in a project, backed by the open Open Ethics Standard catalog. Reports are built locally. No account or API key required.

- [Agent guide](https://ike5.github.io/open-ethics-standard/agent-setup.md): The review workflow, report format, and reply format. Start here.
- [Report script](https://ike5.github.io/open-ethics-standard/oes-report.mjs): Single-file Node.js tool to search the catalog and build the offline report locally.
- [Hosted MCP](https://mcp.codebylevel.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP endpoint serving catalog tools and the workflow.
- [The standard](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard/blob/main/OPEN-ETHICS-STANDARD.md): Canonical practice definitions.
- [Source](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard): MCP source and contribution guide.
